get_example_data: get example model and input data from the torchray benchmark module
get_module: get a specific submodule from a PyTorch model by its dotted path string
Probe: create a Probe on a model layer to capture its output tensor during forward pass
ExcitationBackpropContext: use ExcitationBackpropContext as a context manager to enable excitation backprop during a forward and backward pass
gradient_to_excitation_backprop_saliency: convert captured gradient data from a Probe into an excitation backprop saliency map
